description: This file is a PHP class definition for the 'Voucher' model in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for managing vouchers such as adding, deleting, disabling, retrieving, and handling voucher histories.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Represents the Voucher model in the checkout process, responsible for voucher management.

methods.name: addVoucher
methods.description: Adds a new voucher to the database linked to a specific order ID.

methods.name: deleteVouchersByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes all vouchers associated with a particular order ID.

methods.name: disableVoucher
methods.description: Sets the status of a voucher linked to an order to disabled (0).

methods.name: getVoucher
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a voucher using its code.

methods.name: getVoucherByCode
methods.description: Fetches voucher details, including theme and description, based on the voucher code.

methods.name: getVoucherTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount used/credited for a specific voucher.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Records a new transaction or usage of a voucher into the voucher history.

methods.name: deleteHistoriesByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes all voucher history records associated with a specific order ID.
